title: Automated domain enforcement and invite policy controls for org/team management
creator: Priya Kapoor
description: Objective: Implement organization- and team-level invite policies that enforce domain verification, email allowlist/denylist behavior, and SSO tenant scoping, integrated with RBAC v2 and full audit trails. Background: Current invite flow allows ad-hoc invites which causes compliance gaps for regulated customers and increases attack surface. This ticket implements automated enforcement rules, a migration path for existing orgs, admin override flows with justification logging, and comprehensive event logging for incident investigation. Scope: backend policy engine, admin console UI, SSO/SAML tenant rule checks, invite token lifecycle (expirations/soft-blocks), audit logging for all invite-related events, RBAC v2 mapping for new admin roles, telemetry and canary rollout. Out of scope: third-party identity provider plugins beyond SAML/OIDC canonical behavior and enterprise compliance reporting exports (follow-up).
acceptance_criteria: Org-level policy object exists and can be updated via API and console
Invite API enforces allowlist and denylist for emails and domains
SSO tenant-scoped invites are soft-blocked if domain mismatch and produce a gated admin override flow
All invite create/accept/revoke events are logged to audit stream with actor, method, policy decision, and token metadata
RBAC v2 role mappings allow an "Org Security Admin" to manage invite policies without full org admin rights
Migration job migrates existing org settings to the new policy model with dry-run and rollback
E2E tests for console + API with SAML flows and audit asserts pass on CI
comments: 2026-02-10 - Priya Kapoor: Created ticket after compliance review with Sales team; customers complaining about accidental cross-domain invites.

2026-02-18 - Engineering design sync: Opted for two policy modes: Enforce (hard-block) and Soft-Enforce (block with admin override + email notification). Chose to implement soft-block default to reduce user friction.
2026-02-25 - Security review: Audit schema must include policy_id, decision_reason, and admin_override_reason. Added to acceptance criteria.
2026-03-02 - PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4217 (policy engine + migration). Waiting for code review.

2026-03-04 - QA: Began integration tests against SAML test tenant; observed token expiry race in high-latency regions. Added a mitigation to extend invite token TTL for pending SSO validation by 5 minutes.
2026-03-05 - Product feedback: Add guidance text in console for 'Soft-Enforce' to set expectations with admins. UX ticket split to DES-2142.
Blocked: need RBAC v2 API extension (dependency ENG-18550) to support fine-grained administrative roles before final rollout.
